name: stripe-webhook
title: Stripe Webhook Receiver
description: A Stripe webhook endpoint with signature verification already wired, so you are not implementing security-critical code from a blog post.

env.description: Signing secret for this webhook endpoint. Every request is rejected unless it carries a signature made with it.
env.where_to_find: Stripe Dashboard → Developers → Webhooks → your endpoint → "Signing secret" → Reveal. It starts with whsec_. The secret only exists once the endpoint does, so if you have not created it yet, leave this blank and set it after the deploy prints your URL.

post_deploy:
Your webhook endpoint is live at {{url}}

To finish:
  1. Stripe Dashboard → Developers → Webhooks → Add endpoint, and paste that URL.
  2. Choose the events to send. The handler already covers checkout.session.completed,
     payment_intent.succeeded, payment_intent.payment_failed and customer.subscription.deleted.
  3. Copy the endpoint's signing secret and store it:
       wawesome env set STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET whsec_... --secret
  4. Send a test event from the dashboard, then watch it arrive:
       wawesome logs --follow
